change: Acquire a bounded prefix of the next original fused expert wave while queued current-wave consumers compute. Drain every current consumer before release, then finish acquiring the full next wave before computing it. Speculative capacity BUSY stops lookahead; public persistent BUSY and failure/cancellation drain and release both lease sets.
invariants: Acquire the initial full wave with the existing public BUSY behavior.
After queueing current compute, acquire a prefix of the next original wave; speculative BUSY stops lookahead without source I/O or publication.
Drain all current consumers before releasing any current lease, then complete the next wave before queueing it.
Hard failures drain every consumer and release both current and prefetched leases. No leases survive a public BUSY return.

No extra activation/staging allocation, GPU API, thread or model-specific rule. Extra live weights consume only existing temporary/decode cache slots. Two bounded32-entry lease arrays add bounded call-stack metadata; request-owned stats bytes are quoted by sizeof(TrellisForward).
Counters describe acquisitions before an explicit fence, not measured GPU overlap.
ownership: Only transformer orchestration and counters change. No model/quant semantics, GPU backend, arithmetic, router, split-K width, expert order, full-wave geometry, compute launch count or cache/staging quota change. Two bounded lease arrays are call-stack metadata; the16-byte request stats growth remains quoted through sizeof(TrellisForward).
precision_scope: Existing independently qualified adapted F16 contract; not original Diffbot full-runtime equivalence.

workload.candidate: Bounded expert-wave lookahead; both binaries already use shared fused projections and RAM huge-page hints
workload.reason: Prospective fixed paired comparison of the current candidate against its saved pre-change product binary
workload.scope: Bounded expert-wave lookahead, current shared-fused CUDA product before/after. Two identical1026-token cohorts,2live,4requests,1output each. No trace or memory sampler in these runs.
workload.timing: Client receipt of first flushed admission to last flushed completion; cold and reused cohort windows separately. Target wait4 RSS/fault/CPU/IO counters after exit.
workload.cache_state: Application cache empty for every process. Two excluded old/new warmup processes precede measurements to prime source filesystem pages; record actual target filesystem-input counters.
acceptance: Exact immutable source token/text/position prefixes in every run; independent full-head controls separate.
Same logical upload/source bytes, pool geometry and cache/host/device caps.
At least5% gain in paired geometric mean warm-cohort throughput, with cold-cohort geometric mean latency no worse than1.05x. Minor faults are descriptive, not an acceptance target.
All timed target filesystem-input counters must be zero for the OS-warm comparison claim.
Keep every run and reject/revise an unhelpful candidate; do not retune workload after seeing results.

prefill.interpretation: Three fixed paired measurements:15.382% higher warm-prefill throughput,4.704% lower cold-cohort latency,7.708% higher total burst throughput. Both binaries already use shared fused kernels and expert-RAM huge-page advice; this isolates lookahead for the declared repeated1026-token profile.

plan.scope: Untraced static mixed prefill/decode A/B/B/A2050/1026 tokens,2live,chunk2048,5outputs each; same quotas and both binaries as prefill pairs.
plan.acceptance: Exact independent token/text/position prefixes; same compute and upload bytes; managed quotas; paired geometric mean mean-ITL and nearest-rank p95-ITL ratios new/old <=1.05, all timed filesystem inputs zero. Client receipt intervals between successive tokens include real serving interference. Four intervals per request,16 per process; this small static check does not qualify sustained tail SLOs.

mixed_prefill_decode.scope: Client-visible token intervals in the declared static mixed workload, including scheduler interference from prefill; not decode-only or sustained-serving tail qualification.

trace.instrumentation: Diagnostic GNU linker/NVTX wrappers plus read-only placement statistics; timing excluded from performance acceptance.
trace.interpretation: Recorded copy/kernel overlap proves real concurrency. Most copy time remains unhidden; host placement can also overlap compute. Trace durations are not predicted end-to-end savings.

correctness.criteria: Exact full-vocabulary F32 bytes, IDs, text, positions against unchanged independent references. Timing runs separately check all emitted token/text/position prefixes.

validation.real_pressure: Normal and sanitizer: held BUSY after65 successful borrows, partial-prefetch cleanup, exact retry,64-attempt cancel with unpublished outputs and discarded backend state.

memory.physical_allocation_change: Can retain16 more temporary expert bundles,213049344 additional bytes, within the already reserved48-slot capacity. No new quota or staging/activation allocation.
memory.interpretation: Managed reservations and temporary allocated/charged counters are checked independently. Process RSS includes instrumented target overhead; exact total physical device/setup peak and an OS physical memory cap are not claimed.

reproduction.raw_evidence: Exact argv, client receipt timestamps, outputs, stderr, wait4 resources, diagnostic report and SQLite retained; immutable source and binary guards before/after each run.

limitations: One checkpoint, adapted numerical profile, GPU and three performance pairs; not a universal or vLLM-relative gain.
Accepted performance uses OS-warm source pages; expert application caches start empty and retain for the second cohort.
Prefetch helps only the shared fused path. Folded FFNs, small rows and decode keep their established execution paths.
Diverse working-set/offload policy qualification, broad four-family resident/offload performance and sustained SLOs remain open.
CPU AVX2/AVX512/NEON and Metal whole-model qualification remain open.
Full goal and release readiness remain false.
